answer: Make reputation age-weighted and graph-checked: a new identity starts at dawn with near-zero voting weight that grows only as unrelated, established peers attest its work over many epochs. Sybil clusters mostly vouch for each other, so trust-flow from seed nodes into them is thin and their scores stay hollow. Cap how much weight any one cluster can pass inward, and an attacker spinning up more fake accounts just feeds a spiral of diluted, worthless endorsements.
